text:
Alex: heads-up — hitting 413s on /embeddings when tenants send arrays of mixed dims (768 + 1024) in a single request. Route picked the new soft-split path but it errors instead of splitting. repro in prod: tenant T-42. anyone seen this?

Maya: saw a couple similar alerts this morning. logs show splitter tried to allocate a slot, then runtime returned 'payload too large' from the backend. :thinking_face:

Owen: likely cause: splitter currently groups by uniform dim only. mixed dims fall through and the async fallback wasn't registered for that ingress route. i'll take a look at router logic.

Sasha: cc @Maya @Owen — ops note: customers are getting latency spikes due to client retries after 413s. we need to avoid the 413->retry loop (and noisy dashboards).

Alex: proposal: add an upfront negotiation header or a soft preflight that returns a structured hint instead of throwing 413. e.g. server returns 200 with a hint { "action": "split_async" } so SDKs can transparently reattempt server-side. better UX than immediate 413.

Maya: +1 on hints but must be instrumented. put a telemetry tag like `embed_split_strategy=async_promoted` so we can surface counts in the console. also want console to show when a request was promoted vs accepted.

Owen: implementation note: preflight roundtrip costs cpu. prefer a cheap header-exchange: client sends `X-Embed-Dims: 768,1024` and `X-Approx-Bytes: 12345` and ingress decides routing synchronously. avoids new HTTP roundtrip.

Sasha: header idea SGTM. rollout concerns: feature flag per-tenant + canary on internal teams before wide release. also need a mitigation path if header absent.

DevEx: SDK changes required. we can implement transparent behavior: on receiving a server hint, the SDK will split client-side or call a dedicated async endpoint. will add a small patch for JS/py that retries once automatically.

Alex: telemetry requirements: track metric `embed.split.failure` with tags (tenant, route, split_type) and `embed.split.latency`. add dashboard panels for 413→retry loops and success rate after promotion.

Maya: also request alerting: if `embed.split.failure` > 5/min for 5m -> page oncall. make it noisier for prod, quieter for internal canary.

Owen: i'll open a PR on split-router to add header-negotiation and wire async fallback. i'll include metrics emission points and a feature flag gate. will add unit tests for mixed-dim grouping.

Sasha: ops rollout checklist:
- canary tenant list (internal + 2 pilot customers)
- console flag toggle (on/off per-tenant)
- baseline dashboard panels + annotation for canary start
- rollback playbook (route revert + feature flag off)

DevEx: drafting SDK snippet and release notes. example in pseudo-JS to demonstrate header usage and hint handling:
```
// JS pseudo
const resp = await client.embeddings(docs, { headers: { "X-Embed-Dims": "768,1024", "X-Approx-Bytes": "12345" } });
if (resp.hint?.action === 'split_async') {
  await client.embeddingsAsyncSplit(docs);
}
```

Alex: thanks. Owen/Maya — can we sync in 30 to lock PRs and telemetry schemas?

Owen: on it, starting branch now.

Maya: joining the sync.

InfraBot: deploy status: split-router-v2 queued for canary on prod-edge-3 (job 77821).

Alex: please make sure the dashboard includes a small panel showing `embed.split.hint_rate` and `embed.split.retry_success` by tenant for the first 24h.

Sasha: noted, will add to the dashboard PR.
